# MixAuto package map (one line each — open topic rule / skill before deep reads)

Root guide: AGENTS.md | Verify: powershell.exe -File "./scripts/verify-debug.ps1" | Tools: powershell.exe -File "./scripts/run-tool.ps1" (never python -c; never .\scripts\ in Git Bash/Zed)
Local agent cold start: /local-opencode-loop first; map bugs → /local-map-triage or /map-bug; plan only → /map-plan (Zed Ask profile); OpenCode also uses opencode.json + .opencode/commands/
Zed skills: .agents/skills/ (junctions to .opencode/skills/) | Slash: /map-bug /map-plan /local-map-triage /local-map-feature /local-apk
Zed: profile MixAuto Write/Ask (no list_directory) + mixauto-qwen3-coder:30b/:14b (tools/ollama; <tool_call><function=…>) | create: .\scripts\create-mixauto-ollama-models.ps1 | notes: .zed/README.md
Never list_directory on . (empty → stall); skill-first then grep/read_file/terminal
OpenCode skills (same bodies): .opencode/skills/local-map-triage | local-map-feature | local-opencode-loop | local-apk

## Packages

MainActivity.kt — entry; permissions; wires MapHostViewModel → DashboardScreen
domain/map/ — CarMapEngine port, MapUiState, SearchResultPlace (thin contracts)
domain/media/ — MediaPlaybackState
data/map/ — MapLibre facade + GPS/puck/camera/style/route/POI collaborators (mix-auto-map-engine.mdc)
data/navigation/ — turn-by-turn TTS, step phrases (mix-auto-navigation.mdc)
data/places/ — offline Overture POI SQLite + encountered places (mix-auto-places.mdc)
LocalPlacesRepository.kt — Overture POI SQLite open/search; download/import/asset install delegates to LocalPlacesDownloader
LocalPlacesDownloader.kt — HTTP/asset/URI pack copy + gzip; open/readMeta stay on the repo
data/media/ — MediaSessionRepository, MediaSessionParsers, album art, audio resume (mix-auto-media.mdc)
MediaSessionRepository.kt — session attach, boot/resume, transport; metadata/like/shuffle parsers in MediaSessionParsers
MediaSessionParsers.kt — title/art/like/shuffle readers from MediaMetadata / PlaybackState
data/location/ — Nominatim reverse geocode helpers
data/apps/ — launchable apps for drawer/dock
data/update/ — app update checks
data/weather/ — weather fetch (if used by HUD/settings)
ui/map/ — MapHostViewModel (activity-scoped engine holder; keep thin)
ui/dashboard/ — DashboardScreen, MediaPlayerPane, dock layouts (mix-auto-dashboard-ui.mdc)
ui/components/ — map container, search, POI drawer, settings panels, overlays
ui/settings/ — LauncherViewModel, preferences, MapDataViewModel, DeveloperSettings.kt (hardcoded compile-time toggles)
ui/theme/ — Color, CarDimensions, Type, MixAutoTheme
ui/onboarding/ — first-run permission wizard
ui/status/ — status bar pieces
ui/media/ — media ViewModel helpers
service/ — notification listener, offline map download service

## data/map owners (do not grow MapLibreEngineImpl)

MapLibreEngineImpl.kt — facade / wiring only (~1k; prefer collaborators); still owns NAV_TILT_OFFSET companion (live)
MapOverlayIds.kt — POI/traffic/custom-pin layer IDs + resolveMapOverlayAnchorLayerId (shared constants)
MapViewHostCoordinator.kt — MapView create/reuse, lifecycle forwards, style-load orchestration
InitialLocationResolver.kt — cold-start GPS bootstrap before first style load
RouteModels.kt — LegStep, RouteResult, route layer/progress constants
PoiOverlayCoordinator.kt — POI cache, mix overlay refresh, preview layers, native poi_* visibility
PoiSelectionController.kt — POI focus/dismiss, saved pins, custom pin, formatLatLng
FreeDriveSessionCoordinator.kt — startFreeDrive, recenterCamera, applyFreeDriveToMap sequencing
RouteOverviewController.kt — route overview bounds/hold timer, then nav camera dive
DestinationSearchCoordinator.kt — destination search merge (local/cache/Photon)
SearchOriginResolver.kt — search origin resolution (GPS / map center / PH fallback)
PhotonSearchClient.kt — Photon HTTP fetch for destination + nearby POI
PoiQueryCoordinator.kt — POI cache search, tile query, nearby merge, viewport seed
LighterTrafficHelper.kt — TomTom alternate scoring / route conversion (pure); passes trafficSections
TomTomTrafficClient.kt — thin facade delegating to TomTom* split below
TomTomTrafficModels.kt — traffic models + shared level/street/haversine formatters
TomTomApiKeyVerifier.kt — TomTom API key probe
TomTomIncidentHeadlines.kt — nearby incident headlines + TTL cache
TomTomRouteJamFinder.kt — route-corridor jam lookup
MapInteractionController.kt — map tap/long-press, custom pin draft, reverse geocode
NavigationSessionCoordinator.kt — navigate, startNavigation, reroute, lighter-traffic alternate; routeTrafficSections on applyActiveRoute; maneuver-fork prefetch/adopt
ManeuverAlternatePlanner.kt — pure per-turn fork math (5 min gate, next-turn pick, adopt)
ManeuverAlternateCoordinator.kt — stash OSRM forks at Navigate, grey next-turn line, adopt RouteResult
OfflineRegionCatalog.kt — offline_regions.json catalog load
OfflineRegionMetadata.kt — offline region SDK metadata parse / resumability
OfflineProgressFormatting.kt — offline progress/size formatters + OfflineRegionInstallState, PendingOfflineResume
OfflineRegionDownloadSession.kt — offline create/observe/prepare/stall-kick (internal)
SmoothingLocationEngine.kt — puck blend + extrapolation (do not split frame loop)
LocationTrackingController.kt — GPS tick chain, applyAndroidLocation, puck force
LocationAcquisitionHelper.kt — permission/retry/poll GPS acquisition
NavigationProgressEvaluator.kt — step advance / arrival / off-route tick (OffRouteDetector injected)
NavigationCameraController.kt — free-drive / nav dive / cameraSessionId; applyFollowZoom; updateDrivingZoomForSpeed (GPS wired; fill body for speed zoom); updateNavigationZoomForDistance
DrivingViewportPaddingController.kt — driving padding compute/apply + dedup caches
TopDownPoiCameraController.kt — POI preview / top-down explore camera
NavigationZoom.kt — maneuver-distance follow zoom math (pure); append new formulas AFTER shouldApplyZoomChange + tests (Turn A); never nest inside targetZoomForManeuverDistance
DrivingTilePrefetcher.kt — tile prefetch while driving + network gate
PoiOverlayRenderer.kt — mix POI icon/text layers, native poi_* visibility; mix poiTextOnly* = VIEWPORT (detached pan only — hidden while navigating)
MapStyleController.kt — style load, traffic, 3D buildings, road boost; nav label stretch → run-tool check_driving_text_pitch / fix_driving_text_pitch (layout pitch; never layer root)
RouteCongestion.kt — TomTom magnitude→color + congestion FeatureCollection for remaining route
RouteRenderer.kt — route GeoJSON greying + data-driven congestionColor when sections present (not puck motion)
OffRouteDetector.kt — parallel-street off-route confirms
ConventionalRouteSelector.kt / NavigationRouteFetcher.kt — OSRM conventional + fetch
OfflineMapRepository.kt — offline tile catalog + public download/pause/delete API (session extracted)

## ui/components (destination search / map HUD / map data)

NavigationSearchOverlay.kt — NavigationSearchContent panel shell (query, lists, loading)
VoiceDestinationSearch.kt — SpeechRecognizer + mic permission + rememberVoiceSearch
SearchPlaceHelpers.kt — SearchResultRow, distance/dedup helpers, saved-place filter
CarMapViewContainer.kt — MapView AndroidView + lifecycle; overlay call sites
MapHudOverlays.kt — nav HUD, toolbar, search/settings FABs, speed circle, lighter-traffic chip
OfflineRegionRow.kt — offline region row + delete/update confirm dialogs
OfflinePackRowActions.kt — PackRowActions, OfflineDownloadStatusHints, ActionRow

## ui/dashboard (media / album art)

MediaPlayerPane.kt — now-playing shell + album-art gestures (pointerInput stays here)
MediaPlayerIdleArt.kt — idle manual-link / default-player art + launchManualFallbackLink
MediaTransportControls.kt — SourceAppButton, MediaControlButton, GestureHintDialog
AlbumArtDisplay.kt — AlbumArtMode enum, PlainAlbumArt, AlbumArtModePicker router
AlbumArtVinyl.kt — VinylAlbumArt spinning record overlay
AlbumArtVisualizer.kt — VisualizerAlbumArt, DockMiniVisualizer, spectrum bar math

## Agent habits

- Load one topic rule or skill per task (OpenCode/Zed: open .mdc by path; globs may not auto-load; re-read line ranges if outline-only)
- Files >~300 lines: grep / signature skim first; full-read only the edit target
- New collaborators: prefer <~300 lines; cohesive ~350 OK if split breaks a bug class — no hard 150-line rewrite of existing debt
- Explicit return types on new public/internal APIs; no mass-annotate private helpers
- Never claim success without BUILD SUCCESSFUL or MIXAUTO_VERIFY_DONE exit=0
- Gradle done = done: BUILD SUCCESSFUL / BUILD FAILED / MIXAUTO_VERIFY_DONE in stream/metadata OR repo-root MIXAUTO_VERIFY_DONE.txt means finished even if bash UI still shows Running — do not re-run
- Verify: powershell.exe -File "./scripts/verify-debug.ps1" (Zed/Git Bash) or ./scripts/verify-debug.ps1 (native PowerShell); never .\scripts\ under bash; stamp file is gitignored
- Label pitch: powershell.exe -File "./scripts/run-tool.ps1" check_driving_text_pitch / fix_driving_text_pitch — never python -c / temp_fix.py / indent=2 on driving JSON
- MapLibre tilt: 0° = overhead; higher = more pitched; overhead request → decrease tilt or NAV_TILT_OFFSET; more nav pitch → increase NAV_TILT_OFFSET; report nav = freeDriveTilt + NAV_TILT_OFFSET (not free-drive alone)
- Follow zoom (speed + nearer turn): stage Turns A→B→C via local-map-feature recipe; GPS already calls updateDrivingZoomForSpeed; free-drive guards = canApplyFreeDriveFollowZoom (not canApplyDynamicNavigationZoom)
